about: Settings of the live sourcing module (mechloop/sourcing). Every figure that is a planning assumption rather than a distributor or shop figure says so in its note.

pacing_s.note: minimum gap between calls: Mouser limits calls per minute (about 30), element14 about 2 per second, Digi-Key 120 per minute

prefer_home_currency_note: the best offer is taken from distributors pricing in USD (Digi-Key, Mouser, Newark) when one holds the quantity; Farnell (GBP, ships from the UK) only when none does

fx_to_usd.note: planning conversion for comparing Farnell (GBP) offers with USD ones; not a quoted rate. Best offers are chosen in USD after this conversion and a converted price is marked as such.

in_stock_ship_note: distributor shipping estimate for an in-stock item, order to arrival (planning default; Digi-Key / Mouser / Newark ship in-stock US orders the same or next day, ground delivery 1-3 days)
long_lead_note: long_lead when the line's lead time exceeds 14 calendar days (10 business days)
single_source_note: Newark and Farnell are one company (element14); a part only at Newark + Farnell counts as one source

McMaster-Carr.basis: planning default, not API-verified: McMaster ships stocked items the same day; US delivery typically next day to 2 days (no API access: client-certificate API requested, docs/ROADMAP.md)

MISUMI.basis: planning default, not API-verified: MISUMI USA states ship days per configured item on its pages (misumi-ec.com refuses bots); 2020 profile cut to length and T-nuts are typically 1-4 ship days + ground

maker-direct.basis: planning default, not API-verified: maker shops must ship from a US warehouse or through a US reseller (domestic only); 5 business days assumed until each line records its US seller

unknown.basis: planning default for a line with no seller identified (placeholder)

order_date_default: next business day after the run

assembly_business_days.note: bench time per sub-assembly and for the final assembly; 0 = not modelled (the schedule gives the earliest start, not the finish)

domestic_only_note: owner, 2026-11-20: prefer US sellers; an overseas seller (e.g. Farnell UK, maker shops abroad) only when no US seller holds the quantity AND its shipping cost is low; the report states shipping cost and extra lead time and flags the line 'overseas'.
